name: 🎬 BALI 2 - Kook (demo: one click, everything to your phone)

parameters.jsCode:
// ============ KOOK SETTINGS (DEMO) ============  edit these, nothing else
// Every message this run sends comes to YOU: the boys' group chat is your Telegram,
// Ketut and the scooter guy are your mobile, and the QR codes land in your inbox.
return [{ json: {
  FILMING: true,
  CREW: ['You', 'Josh', 'Matt', 'Ben'],
  ME: 'You',
  MY_PHONE: '+61400000000',              // YOUR mobile (every 'WhatsApp' in the demo lands here)
  MY_EMAIL: 'you@example.com',            // where the QR entry pack lands
  TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: 'YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID',  // you, or your group chat
  TWILIO_FROM: '+61400000001',            // your Twilio number
  KETUT_VIA_WHATSAPP: false,              // true = Ketut's texts arrive as WhatsApp (join the Twilio sandbox first)
  TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM: '+14155238886',   // Twilio's WhatsApp sandbox number
  KETUT_PHONE: '+61400000000',            // demo: your phone plays Ketut
  SCOOTER_PHONE: '+61400000000',          // demo: your phone plays the scooter guy
  KETUT_CAR: 'white Toyota Avanza',
  HOME_AIRPORT: 'PER',
  BREAK: { name: 'Uluwatu', spotId: '5842041f4e65fad6a7708b4b', lat: -8.8149, lng: 115.0884 },
  MIN_SURF_FT: 6,                          // Surfline face height, the "six foot" in the script
  MIN_DAYS: 3,
  IDEAL_FT: 7,                             // the 6am pick favours waves closest to this size
  FORCE_SWELL: true,                       // filming only: if it's flat today, use a pumping week
  VILLA_BUDGET_PP_NIGHT: 120,              // AUD per person per night
  COSTS_IDR: { evoa: 500000, levy: 150000, scooterDay: 80000, ketutAirport: 350000, ketutSurfDay: 400000, bintang: 45000 },
  BEERS_PER_DAY: 4,
  VISION_MODEL: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  MORNING_BREAKS: [
    { name: 'Uluwatu',       spotId: '5842041f4e65fad6a7708b4b' },
    { name: 'Padang Padang', spotId: '5842041f4e65fad6a7708d44' },
    { name: 'Bingin',        spotId: '5842041f4e65fad6a7708d3b' },
    { name: 'Balangan',      spotId: '5842041f4e65fad6a7708d3a' },
    { name: 'Keramas',       spotId: '5842041f4e65fad6a7708d4e' },
  ],
  PASSPORT_PROMPT: "This is the photo page of a passport. Read the two machine-readable zone (MRZ) lines printed at the very bottom, exactly as printed, character for character. Each line is 44 characters and uses < as the filler. Do not correct or guess anything. Reply with one line of JSON only: {\"line1\":\"...\",\"line2\":\"...\"}. If the MRZ is not readable, reply {\"error\":\"<why>\"}.",
  SCRATCH_PROMPT: "You are documenting a rental scooter at handover so the renter can't be charged for damage that was already there. List every visible scratch, scuff, dent, crack, missing part or worn tyre, with where it is on the bike. Read the number plate if you can. Be specific and don't invent anything you can't see. Reply with one line of JSON only: {\"plate\":\"<plate or null>\",\"colour\":\"...\",\"damage\":[{\"where\":\"...\",\"what\":\"...\",\"size\":\"small|medium|large\"}]}",
} }];

parameters.content:
## 1 · Watch the swell 🌊
Surfline every 6h. Fires on 6ft+ and offshore, 3 days straight, starting tomorrow.

## 2 · The hunt 🔎
Cheapest flights, the closest villa to the break within budget, then EVERYTHING per person at today's rupiah rate.

parameters.message:
🔒 Lock in or miss out?

Whoever locks in, Kook grabs their passport and sorts the electronic visa, the arrival card and the Bali entry tax.

parameters.formDescription: Snap the photo page of your passport, flat and in good light. Kook reads it, checks every digit, then sorts your electronic visa, arrival card and the Bali entry tax.

values.formSubmittedText: Got it 🤙 Kook's on it. Check the group chat.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Kook settings').first().json.VISION_MODEL, max_tokens: 300, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'image/jpeg', data: $json.image_b64 } }, { type: 'text', text: $('Kook settings').first().json.PASSPORT_PROMPT } ] }] }) }}

parameters.text: =😢 Missed out. Enjoy the 9 to 5. Kook will let you know how good it was.

parameters.content:
## 3 · Lock in or miss out 🔒
One tap. Then Kook grabs the passport: Claude reads the MRZ, and all 5 ICAO check digits + the 6-month rule are verified in code.

## 4 · Book it ✈️
Flights held with every passport attached (Duffel). Villa booked by a browser agent.

parameters.text: =🛂 Visa ✓ 📝 Arrival card ✓ 🌴 Bali tax ✓ Three QR codes are in everyone's inbox. We walk straight past the visa line.

parameters.content:
## 5 · The paperwork 🛂
A one-time card capped at exactly IDR 650k. A browser agent fills the three official .go.id sites. Three QR codes land in your inbox.

## 6 · Land → Ketut 🛬
The second the wheels touch down, Ketut gets the flight, the headcount and a name sign.

parameters.message: =Hi Made! {{ $('Kook settings').first().json.CREW.length }} scooters to {{ $('Best villa within budget').first().json.villa.name }} today at 3pm please, {{ $('Evaluate swell').first().json.nights }} days, surf racks on all of them. I'll send photos at handover 🙏

parameters.text: =🛵 Scooters are here. Before anyone rides, snap every bike: {{ $execution.resumeFormUrl }}

parameters.formDescription: One photo per side of every bike, plus anything that's already scratched. Kook logs every mark and sends the report to the owner so nobody gets stung when we hand them back.

values.formSubmittedText: Logged 🤙 Kook's writing up the report.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Kook settings').first().json.VISION_MODEL, max_tokens: 600, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'image/jpeg', data: $json.image_b64 } }, { type: 'text', text: $('Kook settings').first().json.SCRATCH_PROMPT } ] }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## 7 · Scooters 🛵
Booked on WhatsApp. At handover Claude logs every scratch from your photos, and the owner gets the report for a timestamped OK.
